note: DT.5j (Kina / quokka-stack dead_symbol false positives, Go cluster): a call through a struct field typed with a package-qualified type whose bare name two packages declare (`store docstore.Store` beside fx.Store, `tokens *tokens.Registry` beside screening.Registry; LA.23c recorded the bare name, so no lookup was unique), the field read through the DECLARING file's import (Ledger's `reg` is tokens in ledger.go and screening in ledger_ops.go), interface dispatch through a range value over a slice / map field, a local typed by a func literal's result and declared twice in one fn scope (`o := NewOXR(id)` inside the src literal, `o := src(..)` inside t.Run), a method on a composite literal, a method value passed as an argument and a package var initialised to a func (USES), `pkg.F` route handlers in files of the imported package other than the one its import binds, and (the 2026-10-17 correction) a USES from the enclosing fn / METHOD / package var to the in-repo STRUCT a composite literal `T{..}` / `&T{..}` / `pkg.T{..}` builds (apperr.Error is built only by `var notAvailable = &Error{..}`, so the runtime's `Error() string` on it is withheld from dead_symbol once the STRUCT has that incoming edge). Forbid rows are the look-alikes: the other Store / Registry, the call site file's own `reg` import, a lone range name over a map (the key, never the value type), a local whose two declarations name different types (TestMixed: the call is OXR's; a first- or last-declaration guess binds Other's), a same-named type in the test's own directory (apperr.Refusal), an unpassed method, a local func value, a named result and a local const that shadow the package func `handle`, a goroutine call, an unregistered handler, a composite literal of another package's same-named type.
